data.title: IDN Homograph Domain Targeting Crypto Brands
data.description: Detect DNS queries or URL accesses to internationalized domain names (IDN/punycode with xn-- prefix) that visually resemble crypto brand domains (bitpay, coinbase, metamask, phantom, pancakeswap, uniswap, etc.). Interisle documented 2,655 IDN homograph phishing domains with significant crypto brand targeting.
falsepositives: Legitimate internationalized domain names in non-Latin scripts
Localized crypto service providers using native-language domains
